exposure: treatment modality (methotrexate, ultrasound-guided intrasac injection of KCl with methotrexate, surgical management)
outcome: risk factors for conversion from medical to surgical treatment
cohort: Patients admitted and treated for CSP between 2008 and 2016
finding: The incidence of CSP appears to be increasing, and larger MSD, larger trophoblastic mass, and higher β-hCG levels at presentation are associated with increased risk of conversion from medical to surgical management.
